title: Buckwheat Bake with Polish Twist
description: A hearty and flavorful bake that combines the earthiness of buckwheat with a hint of Polish flair.

ingredients.name: Polish Sausage
ingredients.notes: use a vegetarian alternative if preferred

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together buckwheat, ardent flour, and bake spice (if using).
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced Polish sausage to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Add the melted butter to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the bake is golden brown and set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
